analysis_role: Retrospective prediction-instability risk modeling and cross-database fixed-model validation; not clinical utility.

labels.any_flip: argmax(p24) != argmax(p72); p72 is used only to define the outcome

features.admission_harmonization_note: Approximate semantic mapping across databases; not a shared clinical ontology.

model.imputation: training-fold median imputation with missing indicators
model.transport: Train on all source rows; apply unchanged pipeline to target

simulation_definition.timing: At 24 h, risk at or above threshold initiates enhanced monitoring through the 72 h landmark
simulation_definition.primary_trigger: predicted risk of any 24-to-72-hour class flip
simulation_definition.secondary_trigger: predicted risk of major death upgrade
simulation_definition.no_reassessment: No enhanced monitoring after the 24 h landmark
simulation_definition.reassess_all: Enhanced monitoring through 72 h for every patient
simulation_definition.evaluation_horizon: Prediction instability observed by the 72-hour landmark

checks.mimic3_note: MIMIC-III is same-institution different-era; it is not an independent external institution.
checks.simulation_note: Retrospective decision simulation; no clinical utility is claimed.
